reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior loan of up to EUR 150 million in favour of DCT Gdansk Sp. z o.o. ("DCT" or the "Company") and its 100% holding Baltic Hub Sp. z o.o. ("HoldCo"), both incorporated in Poland. EBRD loan will be part of a wider debt package of up to EUR 863.5 million provided jointly with commercial banks to i) refinance the Company's existing debt, ii) capex for construction of Terminal 3, and iii) provide working capital for the Company. EBRD's loan will be focused on capex facility and will contribute to funding construction of Terminal 3, upgrade and renewal of the equipment on Terminals 1 and 2 and additional yard development within the Port of Gdansk. The Project is anticipated to add 1.47 million TEUs of capacity allowing the Company to meet growing demand. The project will also incorporate latest energy efficient technical solutions.
